title: Quaint Spicy Egyptian Chicken Kebabs
description: A kid-friendly Egyptian dish featuring spicy and flavorful chicken kebabs, served with a side of unwaxed lime and fold, making it an ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly option.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together lime juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the kebabs hot with a side of unwaxed lime wedges and fold.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve with your favorite sides, such as rice or roasted vegetables.
